targeted_dictionary_checks.coverage: Partial targeted lookup only; no complete word-by-word dictionary audit.

entries.official_result: Listed as an approved alternative in action/activity entries.
entries.application: This supports the ordinary procedural task sense. Use for a task-record work item remains project terminology; no full conformity claim is made.

entries.official_result: Approved; the listed meaning is a system, function, or feature in a state of action (Part 2, printed page 2-1-A7).
entries.application: The instruction phrase active priority uses a different sense.
entries.suggested_change: Confirm that the task remains open at its assigned priority.

entries.official_result: Unapproved; the entry lists IMPORTANT (adj), BEFORE (prep), and FIRST (adv) as alternatives (Part 2, printed page 2-1-P12).
entries.application: Those alternatives do not preserve the queue-ranking sense. Retain priority as a defined project term if needed; do not make a mechanical substitution.

entries.official_result: Approved with the meaning an official organization that gives approval to something.
entries.application: STATUS.md uses product requirement authority for checklist files. That use does not match the listed meaning.

entries.official_result: Unapproved; the entry lists INDICATION (n) and SIGN (n) as alternatives (Part 2, printed page 2-1-E11).
entries.application: These alternatives may not preserve the project's proof or artifact sense. Keep evidence as a project technical term or define the intended sense; no mechanical replacement was requested.

targeted_dictionary_checks.note: The unresolved terms were considered for clarity and context but were not individually classified against all Technical Noun and Technical Verb categories.

findings_sent_for_frozen_v1.finding: Ready remains separate from each command layer does not explain what Ready or command layer means.
findings_sent_for_frozen_v1.requested_change: State that overall readiness has its own column, separate from build, launch, frame, interaction, exit, restoration, visual, and ownership results.

findings_sent_for_frozen_v1.finding: Product requirement authority applies authority to checklist files, which conflicts with the dictionary sense of an approving organization.
findings_sent_for_frozen_v1.requested_change: Use source of product requirements, or state that product requirements remain in the listed files.

findings_sent_for_frozen_v1.finding: Candidate source S and Report commit P contain unexplained letter labels.
findings_sent_for_frozen_v1.requested_change: Use Candidate commit SHA and Report commit; state that the report commit is available after publication.

findings_sent_for_frozen_v1.finding: Receipt is used without a local definition, and A missing receipt remains NOT_RUN assigns a test state to the receipt.
findings_sent_for_frozen_v1.requested_change: Define run receipt or use run record. For the final sentence, say that a missing receipt keeps the result at NOT_RUN and that an old pass is not current evidence.

findings_sent_for_frozen_v1.finding: One shared real-binary driver is prerequisite to measured visibility is missing an article. The VIS-01, VIS-03, and VIS-04 priority reasons also use dense phrases.
findings_sent_for_frozen_v1.requested_change: Add a before prerequisite or rewrite as A shared driver for real binaries is needed before visibility can be measured. Simplify Expose absent paired execution, accepted scopes, and remain red on real failures.

findings_sent_for_frozen_v1.finding: The accepted VIS-01 owner is ambiguous; active priority does not use the dictionary's approved sense; its output as expected visual output has an unclear referent.
findings_sent_for_frozen_v1.requested_change: Use VIS-01 owner; use task remains open at its assigned priority; say Do not use captures from this branch as expected visual output.

findings_sent_for_frozen_v1.finding: Ambient tooling observations and ambient capability observation are technical and abstract phrases.
findings_sent_for_frozen_v1.requested_change: Use tools available in this environment and state that tool availability does not prove a product check ran.

reviewer_correction.issue: The initial V1 message also named WORK_QUEUE.md:21 as containing product requirement authority.
reviewer_correction.correction: That was inaccurate for the frozen subject. WORK_QUEUE.md:21 says Product requirements remain in the listed files. LANG-V1-02 applies to STATUS.md:26 only; WORK_QUEUE.md:21 has no such finding.

first_corrections_observed_separately.basis: Observed by comparing the earlier, unfrozen draft reviewed before STATUS.md existed with the frozen V1 subject. This comparison does not establish why the changes were made.
items: The frozen V1 instructions identify the VIS-01 owner for publishing the first status report and state what to read before that report exists.
The verification checks use separate sentences and name the candidate commit SHA, claim token, allowed paths, and priority.
The instructions explicitly state that the records are not enforced automatically and name the protected branch, tag, release, and permitted reference-branch updates.
The queue now uses revision 5, matching queue_revision 5 in tasks.json and revision 5 in STATUS.md.
WORK_QUEUE.md:21 now states that product requirements remain in CHECKLIST.md and checklist.json; it does not repeat the authority wording used in STATUS.md:26.
first_corrections_observed_separately.approval_note: These observed corrections are separate from the V1 findings above. They do not approve V1 or any later version.

prior_unfrozen_draft_findings_sent: The earlier draft was missing STATUS.md; the initial-task path needed to name who creates it and what agents should read before it exists.
The first instruction draft used opaque field lists, bootstrap jargon, abstract branch-enforcement wording, unclear expected-output wording, and ambiguous branch/tag/release targets.
The first queue draft used dense terms such as base, token, expiry, atomic acceptance controls, and product requirement authority.
The first draft queue revision did not match its task-record revision; the frozen V1 subject now has revision 5 in both.

verdict.summary: The frozen V1 subject needs the language changes listed above before it is ready for a second language review. The initial V1 status sentence about product requirement authority needs correction only in STATUS.md:26.
